assumptions.notes: 80 is about 4 new inquiry emails each weekday. 900 input tokens and 350 output tokens are one short email and one short draft, not a long thread. Recheck both against a real week before buying anything.

sources.note: The public pricing page lists Starter at 24 euros a month billed monthly, or 20 euros a month billed annually, including 2,500 workflow executions. Prices are in euros. Recheck on the day you subscribe.

List price for prompts up to 100,000 tokens: 0.10 US dollars per million input tokens and 0.50 US dollars per million output tokens. A short inquiry is far under 100,000 tokens, so the higher long-prompt rate does not apply.
